not_selected_reason: Wing/tail at or beyond image boundary, or suspected truncation. Preserve inputs but do not normalize a clipped silhouette as a complete aircraft asset.
limitations: Eight view/photo assets, not eight distinct airframe types.
No image flipping, large homography or generative model was used to turn the dorsal surface into a belly.
Fine propellers, soft white edges and residual subpixel background contamination are not guaranteed perfect.
Product/ground photos are source material, not proof of realistic in-flight lighting; grayscale composition matches local scale, blur and contrast.
